proofs: Name confirmed by Rockstar. We don’t know yet if it can be bought separately.
Listed on the site: seen in official media. We don’t know yet if it can be bought.

items.name: Girardi ES9
items.context: Jason’s personal pistol, named by Rockstar in the Ultimate Edition reveal, which includes an engraved version of it. It’s the most visible handgun in the official media.

items.name: Klose K17
items.context: Lucia’s personal pistol, named by Rockstar, with a rose-engraved version in the Ultimate Edition. A modern pistol with a polymer frame and an accessory rail.

items.name: Nipper .38
items.seen: Name engraved on the weapon, official cover art
items.context: The small pistol Lucia holds on the official cover art. Its name is readable on the slide: it’s one of the few weapons whose name comes straight from a Rockstar image.

items.name: Hawk & Little Morgan
items.context: A pair of engraved revolvers, one for Jason, the other for Lucia, described by Rockstar as inspired by the Vercetti Estate in Vice City. Palm-tree grips, name engravings and a high-performance scope.

items.name: Custom pistol
items.context: A pistol with a custom finish, seen in an indoor scene. The visible finishes suggest that weapon customization is back.

items.name: Select-fire pistol
items.context: A pistol fitted with a fire selector at the back of the slide, a detail visible in the gameplay footage. It would turn a semi-automatic pistol into a burst-fire weapon.

items.name: Mustang .357
items.seen: Name engraved on the weapon, official Ambrosia screenshot
items.context: The big revolver a female biker waves in the third Ambrosia screenshot, as she hangs on the neck of a gang member wearing the Enforcer patch. The name Mustang .357 is engraved on the weapon: it’s the fifth weapon whose name comes straight from a Rockstar image. Vented barrel and big Colt Python cylinder, the classic movie magnum, here in the hands of the backcountry bikers.

items.name: Double-barrel shotgun
items.context: A side-by-side double-barrel shotgun, tied to rural areas and swamps in the official media. The bearded man in the foreground of the sixth Grassrivers screenshot carries one on his shoulder, with engraved fittings and a wooden stock, in front of the alligator hanging in his workshop.

items.name: Pump shotgun
items.context: A classic pump shotgun, sighted during shootout scenes. A short-range weapon typical of the series.

items.name: Tropical-pattern SMG
items.context: A compact submachine gun with a tropical pattern, shown in the Ultimate Edition artwork without Rockstar publishing its name. Usable one-handed, in the tradition of drive-by weapons.

items.name: Compact SMG
items.context: A very short automatic weapon, sighted in a close-quarters action scene.

items.name: Submachine gun
items.context: A submachine gun held two-handed by Jason and Lucia during the Trailer 2 heist. Jason’s version has a red dot sight.

items.name: Folding-stock SMG
items.context: Lying on a car’s bench seat between stacks of cash, with a matching pistol, in the Weapon Pattern artwork of the Vintage Vice City Pack. Folded stock, straight magazine in front of the grip, turquoise palm-tree finish: a modern, compact submachine gun, not the same as the small tropical-pattern SMG Jason holds in the outfit artwork. Its name hasn’t been announced.

items.name: Carbine
items.context: A modern carbine with a telescoping stock, visible in several action sequences.

items.name: Assault rifle
items.context: An assault rifle with a distinctive curved magazine, sighted in the hands of antagonists.

items.name: Bolt-action rifle
items.context: A scoped bolt-action rifle, sighted in a long-range shooting situation.

items.name: Semi-automatic rifle
items.context: The long scoped rifle with a wooden stock held by one of the three men posing in front of their airboat, in the first Grassrivers screenshot. The long receiver and traditional stock recall the M1A, the civilian version of the M14: a hunting and long-range shooting weapon, more rugged than the bolt-action rifle, and right at home in the swamps.

items.name: Combat machine gun
items.context: A belt-fed support weapon, the heaviest one sighted so far.

items.name: Baseball bat
items.context: Baseball bat, a recurring melee weapon in the series. The melee animations were redone with motion capture.

items.name: Switchblade
items.context: A knife with a retractable blade, visible in the Ultimate Edition artwork next to the engraved revolvers.

items.name: Golf club
items.context: A golf club you can use as a melee weapon, in the tradition of everyday objects turned into weapons.

items.name: Hammer
items.context: A construction hammer, sighted as an improvised weapon.

items.name: Pool cue
items.context: A pool cue, a melee weapon tied to Leonida’s leisure spots.

items.name: Molotov cocktail
items.context: Molotov cocktail, the series’ classic incendiary throwable.

items.name: Smoke grenade
items.context: Smoke grenade, a non-lethal throwable used to hide your movement.

items.name: Speargun
items.context: Speargun, an underwater weapon. It’s new to the series: it comes with the underwater areas you can explore.

items.name: Grenade launcher
items.context: Lucia holds it during the police chase in Trailer 2, just as a vehicle explodes behind her. The big cylinder sticking out under the barrel leaves no doubt: a Milkor MGL-style revolver grenade launcher, the return of the series’ most spectacular heavy weapon.
